column1: # The 0.7.x output reader of the 0.8-rule retrofit (bridge/rule.cpp): marks, particles, dependent nouns and
# verbalizers it knows, and the quote and speaker-tag marks of the dialogue detector. kind<TAB>value[<TAB>…]
# keigo: an honorific or humble form in the source, read from the analyzer's tokens (UniDic lemmas). A line
# of speech with one keeps 0.7.x's polite level (합쇼체 or 해요체) under the retrofit. Columns: lemma, reading
# prefix, the lemmas that must follow in order (あらせられる: 有る せる られる), a conjugation form that does
# not count ("-" none). 参る and ござる count before ます only (参った! is a casual groan, でござる period
# speech); おる counts as おります (ておる is old speech); ください alone is the plain polite request.
# keigo-prefix: お/ご + verb stem (+ に) + verb: お待ちになる (尊敬), お伺いする, お持ちいたす (謙譲)
# command-form: the analyzer's conjugation form of a command (見ろ, 追え, 黙ってろ). A line of speech with a
# word in it keeps 0.7.x's 해라체 commands (봐라, 쫓아라): orders from kings and officers read naturally in 해라.
